shots.imagePrompt: Ingredients of a smoky garlic crunch burger hang in mid-air one above another with small gaps between them: a toasted sesame bottom bun, a seared beef patty with a dark crust, a melted cheddar slice, golden fried garlic crumbs, crisp green lettuce, and a top bun with a crackly golden garlic-crumb crust. A chef's hand in a black glove has just let go of the top bun at the top of the frame. Centered vertical stack, a thin curl of smoke between the layers, warm amber light from the left with a thin rim light, dark charcoal background, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, vertical 9:16 composition.
shots.motionPrompt: Close macro view: the burger layers hang in the air with small gaps and drift slowly downward together while thin smoke curls around them. Slow push in on the food. Stable shapes, one continuous take.
shots.sound: subtle griddle sizzle with a soft whoosh

shots.imagePrompt: Overhead top-down view of a toasted bottom bun with a lettuce leaf on a dark slate surface. A gloved hand at the top of the frame holds a seared beef patty with a dark crust on a spatula above the bun. Warm amber light from the left with a thin rim light, thin smoke, dark charcoal background, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, vertical 9:16 composition.
shots.motionPrompt: Close overhead macro view, slow push in on the food. The gloved hand lowers the patty onto the bun and it settles with a small bounce, then a second gloved hand lays a cheddar slice over the patty, then a spoon tips golden garlic crumbs onto the cheese until they scatter a little. Each layer lands one after another. One continuous take.
shots.sound: soft pat and bounce as each layer lands, sizzle underneath

shots.imagePrompt: Macro close-up of a crackly golden garlic-crumb crust on top of a toasted burger bun, a serrated knife blade resting on the centre of the crust. Warm amber light from the left with a thin rim light, thin smoke, dark charcoal background, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, vertical 9:16 composition.
shots.endImagePrompt: The same macro close-up, same camera and framing: the burger is now cut cleanly in half, the golden garlic-crumb crust fractured with crumbs falling, melted cheddar and beef patty visible in the cut, and a little steam rising.
shots.motionPrompt: Close macro view, locked camera with a slow push in on the food. The serrated knife presses straight down into the crust until the crust cracks open along the blade, crumbs falling and steam rising, then the burger parts into two halves. One continuous take.
shots.sound: crispy crack as the crust splits
